Hey, I'm Till.

Diptychon started as a personal project. I wanted a file manager I can drive with the keyboard alone, in a design I actually like to look at, and one that makes my everyday workflows simpler.

Diptychon is free. There are no investors, no team and no ads, just me building the tool I want to use and hoping it is useful to you too.

Sponsoring is what keeps that going. It is a simple way to say thanks if you enjoy it, it keeps me motivated, and it shows that small, private Mac tools have a place.

Thank you.
